profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer and Studio Encoding Tech Lead, Video Algorithms at Netflix
profile.summary:
Skilled software engineer and self-motivated learner with diverse work experience.

Co-creator of OpenTimelineIO, a timeline format built-in to Resolve, Media Composer, and Premiere.

I've focused on  film production technology and have done a range of work that spans from back end render farm tasks to end-user facing applications targeted at all stages of the filmmaking process.

Areas of focus: Python, AWS Lambda, Microservice Architecture, Swift/Objective-C development for iOS and OS X, Editorial Intelligence and EDLs, Maya, Previz Process, Pipeline Development, and Post-Production.

Technical Steering Committee member on OpenTimelineIO http://opentimeline.io

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Video Engineering
positions.description:
Building backend services supporting video processing, transcoding, and film post-production workflows.

Work as a consultant for other teams within Netflix on editorial data interchange.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Core contributor to engineering and company process with a focus on client workflows and Media Pipelines.

Key Accomplishments include:
• Worked on small team that lead transition to microservice architecture
• Built massively parallel video processing pipeline using FFmpeg on AWS Lambda to prepare media for secure streaming
• Implemented streaming manifest generation for both HLS and DASH
• Built service for executing complex task trees in the cloud using Python, Flask, and SQLAlchemy
• Wrote Python library for inspecting and manipulating MP4 (ISO BMFF) binary structure
• Wrote Python library for frame-accurate inspection of media characteristics using ffprobe for underlying media inspection
• Wrote Python library providing a high-level abstraction for media transcode and containerization using FFmpeg

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developer on team delivering end-user client applications for collaboration platform focused on motion picture content creators.

Key Accomplishments include:
• Contributed in team environment to frameworks shared by apps on both iOS and OS X
• Used FFMPEG C APIs, OpenGL, and CoreAudio to build prototype video player running in iOS, OS X, and as an NPAPI plugin for Safari
• Built solution for securely storing DRM protected media for offline viewing on iOS and worked through security auditing process
• Contributed to iOS app (https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/pix-system/id438296952) re-build for(2.0 release and later led iOS app team through several releases (about one year)
• Worked closely with client relations team to develop a desktop app for OS X providing streamlined interface for uploading files
• Maintained and enhanced Mac OS X desktop application to provide strong user experiences

positions.title: Pipeline Technical Director
positions.description:
Work with artists and technical leadership within the company to develop and design a 3D Animation pipeline for television production.

Key Accomplishments include:
• Built artist toolset for assembling assets from a library of components allowing for greater reuse and flexibility
• Provided technical advice for 3D story, pre-production assets, and overseas studios
• Lead design of automated asset management tools to run quality assurance tests and checkin to a
unified asset library
• Built a node graph abstraction layer providing a uniform interface across multiple 3D packages
including Maya

positions.title: Jr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working in the Production Engineering Group on development and support of software for 3D animation pipeline and artist tools.

• Developed and supported tools with a focus on 3D animation production pipeline
• Collaborated across multiple Lucasfilm technology teams to bootstrap new show pipelines
• Maintained and enhanced take management system to ensure solid tracking of shot iterations from
story to final
• Helped design a filesystem management abstraction layer to enable tools to be less dependent on file
layout
• Built a custom Maya node to provide asset "level of detail" control within the shot production pipeline
• Created a solution to render animation playblasts on the render farm to free up animators and
workstations

Projects worked on include Star Wars: The Clone Wars, Star Wars: Detours, Strange Magic

positions.title: Associate Technical Director - 3D Story
positions.description:
Day-to-day pipeline and workflow ninja for 3D Story development.

Key Accomplishments:
• Provided directors and 3D story artists with tools and support using innovative storytelling technology from ILM R&D
• Built tools to provide detailed metrics of asset usage within 3D scenes based on what appears in
camera
• Implemented pipeline to provide cameras and other scene data to downstream departments
• Worked closely to with artists to develop tools to speed up everyday workflow

positions.title: Production Coordinator
positions.description:
Point-person for asset production on Star Wars: The Clone Wars.

Key Accomplishments:
• Established strong tracking and production database practices
• Coordinated asset supply chain with multiple overseas vendors and sites
• Worked closely with production tracking database development team
• Monitored "on the ground" situation for asset QC team

positions.title: Post-Production Coordinator
positions.description: Titles Include: Rush Hour 3 and Fracture

positions.title: Post-Production Coordinator
positions.description:
- Scheduled and attended post sessions from the film lab to the mix stage
- Worked with VFX houses and vendors to ensure timely delivery of elements
